raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: Фигурата илюстрира промените в коефициента на разреденост (sparsity ratio) на изхода от SDPA при праг 1e-2 през различните слоеве на модел. Заглавието на графиката е "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2". Оста X е обозначена като "Layer", със линейна скала, обхващаща диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23, с етикети през интервал от 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като "Sparsity Ratio", също с линейна скала, обхващаща стойности от 0.0 до 1.0, с етикети през интервал от 0.2. В графиката са представени три линии. Първата линия, в син цвят с пунктиран стил (тире-точка), представлява "sparsity ratio before gate" със средна стойност 0.03. Тя започва при приблизително 0.18 на слой 0, бързо спада до около 0.04 при слой 2–3 и остава почти постоянна на ниско ниво около 0.02–0.04 през останалите слоеве, като достига близо до 0.0 при слой 23. Втората линия, в оранжев цвят с точков (пунктиран) стил, представлява "sparsity ratio after gate" със средна стойност 0.44. Тя започва при стойност 1.0 на слой 0, намалява стръмно до около 0.6 при слой 5, продължава да спада до приблизително 0.47 при слой 8, след което намалява по-плавно до около 0.15–0.18 при слоеве 14–16, и след това показва колебания между приблизително 0.08 и 0.40 в диапазона от слой 17 до слой 23. Третата линия, в зелен цвят със стил тире-точка и по-едри маркери, представлява "sparsity ratio after average gate" със средна стойност 0.33. Тя започва при приблизително 0.95 на слой 0, спада стръмно до около 0.45 при слой 7, продължава да намалява до около 0.20 при слой 11, след което остава на относително ниско ниво между 0.05 и 0.15 при слоеве 13–19, и показва леко покачване до около 0.10 при последните слоеве (20–23). Легендата е разположена в горната дясна част на графиката и съдържа описание на трите линии заедно с техните средни стойности.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: This figure displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output at a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers of a model. The x-axis represents "Layer," scaled linearly from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Sparsity Ratio," scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Three data series are plotted. The first is a blue dashed line with no visible markers, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," which starts at approximately 0.18 at layer 0, drops quickly to around 0.04 by layer 3, and remains relatively flat near 0.02–0.04 throughout the remaining layers, ending near 0.00 at layer 23. The second is an orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," which begins at approximately 1.0 at layer 0, decreases in a generally downward trend through the layers—passing through roughly 0.75 at layer 4, 0.47 at layer 9, and 0.28 at layer 13—then fluctuates between approximately 0.15 and 0.40 in the later layers, ending near 0.30 at layer 23. The third is a green dash-dot line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," which starts at approximately 0.95 at layer 0, decreases steeply to around 0.58 at layer 5 and continues declining to approximately 0.20 at layer 10, then fluctuates at lower values between roughly 0.05 and 0.15 from layers 13 to 20, before rising slightly to around 0.10 at layer 23.
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: This plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across different layers of a model, using a threshold of 1e-2, comparing three different conditions. The x-axis represents "Layer" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Sparsity Ratio" on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The first line, shown in blue with a dashed line style, represents "sparsity ratio before gate" with an average of 0.03; it starts at approximately 0.18 at layer 0, quickly drops to around 0.04 by layer 3, remains relatively flat near 0.03–0.04 through layers 4 to 20, and decreases slightly to approximately 0.00 by layer 23. The second line, shown in orange with a dotted line style, represents "sparsity ratio after gate" with an average of 0.44; it begins at approximately 1.0 at layer 0, exhibits a generally declining trend through the layers, dropping to around 0.47 by layer 10, continuing to decrease to approximately 0.17 around layer 15, and then fluctuating between roughly 0.10 and 0.40 in the later layers, ending near 0.30 at layer 23. The third line, shown in green with a dash-dot line style, represents "sparsity ratio after average gate" with an average of 0.33; it starts at approximately 0.95 at layer 0, declines steeply to around 0.45 by layer 7, continues decreasing to approximately 0.12 around layer 13, remains relatively low between 0.08 and 0.12 through layers 14 to 21, and shows a slight increase to approximately 0.10 at layer 23.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Dieses Diagramm zeigt das Sparsity Ratio der SDPA-Ausgabe bei einem Schwellenwert von 1e-2 über verschiedene Schichten eines Modells. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet und zeigt eine lineare Skala von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Sparsity Ratio" beschriftet und erstreckt sich linear von 0.0 bis 1.0, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 0.2. Es werden drei Linien dargestellt. Die erste Linie, in Blau mit gestricheltem Linienstil und ohne auffällige Markierungen, repräsentiert das „sparsity ratio before gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.03; sie beginnt bei Layer 0 bei etwa 0.19, fällt schnell auf etwa 0.04 bei Layer 2 und verbleibt danach relativ konstant nahe 0.03 bis 0.04 über die restlichen Schichten, mit einem leichten Rückgang auf nahe 0.0 bei Layer 23. Die zweite Linie, in Orange mit gepunktetem Linienstil, repräsentiert das „sparsity ratio after gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.44; sie beginnt bei Layer 0 bei etwa 1.0, fällt steil ab auf etwa 0.47 bei Layer 8, sinkt weiter auf etwa 0.28 bei Layer 12, zeigt dann Schwankungen zwischen etwa 0.15 und 0.30 im Bereich Layer 13 bis 20, und steigt am Ende bei Layer 23 auf etwa 0.40 an. Die dritte Linie, in Grün mit Strich-Punkt-Linienstil, repräsentiert das „sparsity ratio after average gate" mit einem Durchschnitt von 0.33; sie beginnt bei Layer 0 bei etwa 0.95, fällt ebenfalls deutlich ab auf etwa 0.45 bei Layer 6, sinkt weiter auf etwa 0.20 bei Layer 12, verbleibt dann zwischen etwa 0.05 und 0.12 im Bereich Layer 13 bis 20, und zeigt bei Layer 23 einen leichten Anstieg auf etwa 0.10.
